tldr: Uranus in the 10th house: freedom becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With Uranus in the 10th house, this part of you awakens through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. Uranus describes freedom, disruption, originality, change, and the need to break from stale patterns. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. Uranus can become honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point.
gift: honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
